summary: PHP Ventures Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a $957.30 deposit into its trust account to extend the deadline to consummate an initial business combination by one month, from May 16, 2026, to June 16, 2026. This is a routine SPAC extension filing under Item 8.01. The company is a blank-check issuer that was suspended from Nasdaq trading in April 2024. No business combination terms, premium, or advisor are mentioned. The extension provides additional time to find a target. The risk-arb angle is whether a deal materializes before the extended deadline; failure may lead to liquidation.
